DIAGNOSIS READY: Tyrosinemia type 1.

Based on the classic triad of hypotonia, seizures, a sweet-musty (mousy) odor, and the pending metabolic workup, this newborn presents with Tyrosinemia type 1. The specific musty odor and neurologic symptoms strongly suggest an organic acidemia, and the metabolic panels we ordered will confirm elevated succinylacetone and tyrosine levels.
